# Parameter Specification: O-Strata (v2 — live wave-terrain oscillator)

**CRITICAL CONTRACT:** This specification is immutable during implementation. The Stage 1 second pass (re-parameterise) cannot proceed without this file. All subsequent stages reference these exact parameter IDs, ranges, defaults, choice lists and flags.

**Generated by:** UI mockup finalization (ui-mockup skill, mockup v2) — ui-finalization-agent, 2026-09-10
**Referenced by:** Stage 1 second pass (APVTS layout, `StrataParamIds`, `ModDest`), Stage 2 (DSP — `TerrainOscillator`, Core 1–11), Stage 3 (GUI — relays / attachments / comboBox relays, Terrain tab), Stage 4 (persistence, factory presets)
**Supersedes:** `superseded-baked-v1/parameter-spec.md` (v1, 219 params, baked design — not a source of truth)
**Sources:** `mockups/v2-ui.yaml` `parameters:` (authoritative for the 34 new IDs, ranges, defaults, choice lists and the two in-place changes — finalised 2026-09-10T15:15:37Z) · `parameter-spec-draft.md` v2 (2026-09-08) · `plugins/O-Prism/.planning/params.tsv` (v1.24.0 registry, 173 rows — authoritative for every inherited ID, range, default and flag; unchanged through v1.26.0) · `research/ARCHITECTURE.md` §Parameter Mapping (component / rate per parameter)

## Draft reconciliation

Checked ID-by-ID against `parameter-spec-draft.md` v2: **no conflict** on any ID, type, range, default or choice list — 34 = 34 new, 171 = 171 inherited, and the two in-place changes (`osc?Pos` default 0.5, `osc?Unison` max 4) are stated identically in both. `draftConflictDetected: false`.

Points the draft left open and this spec closes:

- **Mod-destination host strings.** The draft writes the relabelled entries as "Osc A Orbit Size"; ROADMAP Stage 1 second pass writes "OscA Size"; the mockup (YAML `mod_tab.destinations` and the test HTML's fallback list) writes **"OscA Orbit Size"** in O-Prism's existing `OscA Pos` prefix style. The mockup form is locked (§Mod-matrix destinations). These strings are host-facing and **not localised** (STATUS open question 5 resolved as O-Prism does it: `getModDestNames()` from C++).
- **Terrain Freq mapping.** The draft says "log skew"; the mockup readout is exact-log (`value = 0.25 · 32^norm`, 1.00× at norm **0.400000**). Locked as an exact log `NormalisableRange` built from `convertFrom0To1` / `convertTo0To1` lambdas (not a skew factor), so the JS readout and the host automation lane agree to the digit.
- **`osc?Unison` type.** Inherited `AudioParameterInt`, range 1–4 (was 1–8). No migration gate: no O-Strata preset has shipped (ARCHITECTURE "Parameter migration on the fork"); this is the last free range change and is recorded in CHANGELOG at Stage 1.
- **Choice params and relays.** The four new Choice parameters per oscillator ride **`WebComboBoxRelay`** (the `<option>` list is pushed from C++), while inherited Choice parameters keep riding slider relays exactly as O-Prism binds them. See "Relay / attachment plumbing".
- **Terrain choice list.** Seven entries — the six analytic terrains plus `Imported…` **last** (the v1 spec's three-entry list is superseded; ARCHITECTURE Core 3 and the mockup agree on six).

## Terrain / Orbit / Quality block — semantics that bind every parameter below

- **Type:** ordinary APVTS `AudioParameterFloat` / `AudioParameterChoice` in the static layout. All 34 always exist regardless of Terrain / Orbit / Quality (inert controls are greyed, never removed — YAML `inert_rules`).
- **Rate:** parameters marked **mod** are mod-matrix destinations and are smoothed **per sample** at the oscillator (`juce::SmoothedValue`, ~5 ms, Core 9); the rest are **block-rate** (`updateBlockRate`), `osc?TerBlur` debounced 150 ms (Core 8). In Bandlimited mode the terrain destinations are block-rate at the coefficient-swap cadence (ARCHITECTURE D3).
- **automatable: yes · persisted: yes** for every parameter (APVTS state + preset-manager v1.0.6 choice-param migration hook).
- **Choice index stability:** every list is **append-only after v1.0.0 ships**; `Imported…` stays the last Terrain index. Every Choice has ≥ 2 entries (memory `critical_choice_param_needs_two_choices`).
- **ID hygiene:** no suffix shadows a `juce::` free function (memory `critical_paramid_shadows_juce_free_function`) — `Terrain`, `TerFreq`, `TerModX`, `TerModY`, `TerTrack`, `TerSat`, `TerBlur`, `TerEdge`, `Orbit`, `OrbAspect`, `OrbRot`, `OrbCX`, `OrbCY`, `OrbMod`, `OrbFeedback`, `OrbFbDamp`, `Quality` checked against `juce_core` / `juce_audio_basics` free functions; re-grep at Stage 1.
- **Host names** (`AudioParameterFloat` name argument): `"Osc A " + <Label>` in O-Prism's style — e.g. `Osc A Terrain Freq`, `Osc A Orbit Centre X`, `Osc A Quality`. Host names are not part of the contract; IDs, ranges, defaults and choice lists are.
- **UI-only companions (NOT parameters):** per-canvas view mode ⬡/≋, the Terrain tab's active oscillator, the imported PNG blob (see Non-parameter state).

Float steps are 0.001 unless stated (O-Prism convention); `osc?TerFreq` is continuous (step 0). The `×`, `°` and `…` glyphs in choice / unit strings are built through `CharPointer_UTF8` hex escapes in C++ so the source stays ASCII (the fork already does this for `Imported…`).

`StrataParamIds`: `oscIds(prefix)` = rows 1–11 + the **13 Float** rows 13–18, 21–27 (24 slider IDs per oscillator, in this order); **new** `oscComboIds(prefix)` = rows 12, 19, 20, 28 (`Terrain`, `TerEdge`, `Orbit`, `Quality`). The 24 baked suffixes (`GeoSource … TerSweepRange`, `TerOrbit`, `TerCX`, `TerCY`, `TerAspect`, `TerRot`) are deleted; `Terrain`, `TerBlur`, `TerEdge` keep their IDs with the meanings above.

### New parameters — per-parameter definitions (each exists as `oscA…` and `oscB…`)

#### Terrain (what is scanned)

##### `oscATerrain` / `oscBTerrain` — Terrain
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** Sine Product / Radial Rings / Saddle / Ridged Cosines / Mitsuhashi / Cosine Wells / Imported…
- **Default:** Sine Product (normalised 0.000000)
- **Skew Factor:** n/a (choice)
- **UI Control:** Synth-tab dropdown `#select-osc?Terrain` (118 px, where the Shape dropdown was) + Terrain-tab toolbar dropdown `#select-terTerrain` (proxy, same param) — i18n `label.terrain`; comboBox relay
- **DSP Usage:** Core 3 / Core 8: analytic terrain (πF convention) or the imported PNG; selects the Chebyshev coefficient set key (Core 7). `Imported…` with no image → library fallback (Sine Product) + `.terrain-notice`
- **Flags:** block-rate · mod destination: no · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: synth, terrain · append-only, `Imported…` last

##### `oscATerFreq` / `oscBTerFreq` — Terrain Freq
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.25 to 8.0 × (exact log: `value = 0.25 · 32^norm`, `norm = log(value / 0.25) / log 32`)
- **Default:** 1.0 × (normalised 0.400000)
- **Skew Factor:** exact log via `NormalisableRange<float>` lambdas (not a skew factor)
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab primary knob (72 px) `terFreq` — i18n `label.terrainFreq`; readout `1.00×`, **displayed value clamps at 2.00× when Quality = Bandlimited** (ARCHITECTURE D3; the parameter itself is not clamped)
- **DSP Usage:** Core 3 spatial-frequency multiplier F; pitch-tracked `F_eff = F · min(1, C4/f_note)^track`; log-domain modulation (Core 9); Bandlimited mode clamps F ≤ 2 (Core 6)
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**, dest "Osc? Terrain Freq") · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

##### `oscATerModX` / `oscBTerModX` — Terrain Mod X
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.5 (normalised 0.500000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab knob (64 px) `terModX` — i18n `label.terrainModX`; readout `50%`; tip "ring spacing / saddle skew / well depth"
- **DSP Usage:** Core 3 terrain-specific shape input (documented per terrain in ARCHITECTURE Core 3 table); Chebyshev key (Core 7)
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

##### `oscATerModY` / `oscBTerModY` — Terrain Mod Y
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.5 (normalised 0.500000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab knob (64 px) `terModY` — i18n `label.terrainModY`; readout `50%`
- **DSP Usage:** Core 3 second terrain-specific shape input; Chebyshev key (Core 7)
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

##### `oscATerTrack` / `oscBTerTrack` — Pitch Track
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 1.0 (normalised 1.000000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab knob (64 px) `terTrack` — i18n `label.pitchTrack`; readout `100%`; **inert when Quality = Bandlimited** (`.is-inert`)
- **DSP Usage:** Core 9 `updateBlockRate` → Core 3: 1 = harmonic count constant across the keyboard, 0 = fixed spatial frequency (DSP-01 "terrain mip"); no effect in Bandlimited mode (truncation is the mip)
- **Flags:** block-rate · mod destination: no · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

##### `oscATerSat` / `oscBTerSat` — Saturation
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.0 (normalised 0.000000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab knob (64 px) `terSat` — i18n `label.saturation`; readout `0%`
- **DSP Usage:** Core 1: `tanh(g·x)/tanh(g)`, `g = 1 + 7·sat`; identity at 0 (DSP-07); `FastMathApproximations::tanh`
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

##### `oscATerBlur` / `oscBTerBlur` — Image Blur
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.2 (normalised 0.200000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab sub-row knob (56 px) `terBlur` — i18n `label.imageBlur`; readout `20%`; **inert unless Terrain = Imported…**
- **DSP Usage:** Core 8 Gaussian pre-blur of the decoded PNG (background thread, 150 ms debounce); inert for analytic terrains; also drives the "fit %" estimate in the Bandlimited readout until `terrainStatus` pushes the measured value
- **Flags:** block-rate (debounced) · mod destination: no · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

##### `oscATerEdge` / `oscBTerEdge` — Edge Mode
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** Mirror / Window
- **Default:** Mirror (normalised 0.000000)
- **Skew Factor:** n/a (choice)
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab sub-row dropdown `#select-terEdge` (118 px) — i18n `label.edgeMode`; **inert unless Terrain = Imported…**; comboBox relay
- **DSP Usage:** Core 8 PNG edge handling: Mirror = reflect at ±1; Window = Mitsuhashi (1−x²)(1−y²) taper; inert for analytic terrains
- **Flags:** block-rate · mod destination: no · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

#### Orbit (the path)

##### `oscAOrbit` / `oscBOrbit` — Orbit
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** Ellipse / Superellipse / Limaçon / Epitrochoid 3 / Epitrochoid 5 / Epitrochoid 7 / Hypocycloid 3 / Hypocycloid 5 / Hypocycloid 7 / Butterfly / Squarcle
- **Default:** Ellipse (normalised 0.000000)
- **Skew Factor:** n/a (choice)
- **UI Control:** Synth-tab dropdown `#select-osc?Orbit` (106 px, NEW second dropdown) + Terrain-tab toolbar dropdown `#select-terOrbit` (proxy) — i18n `label.orbit`; comboBox relay
- **DSP Usage:** Core 2: closed curve traced once per cycle (θ = phase accumulator, so Sync / Bend / FM / Window warps and unison apply unchanged); trig-polynomial degree K = [1, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 2, 4, 6, 4, 1] feeds Core 6 (Bandlimited is exact for K-degree orbits, approximate for Superellipse / Butterfly / Squarcle — the readout says `approx.`)
- **Flags:** block-rate · mod destination: no · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: synth, terrain · append-only

##### `oscAPos` / `oscBPos` — Orbit Size *(inherited ID, changed in place)*
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0 (step 0.001) — unchanged
- **Default:** **0.5** (normalised 0.500000) — was 0.0 in O-Prism; 0.0 would collapse the orbit to a point → DC → silence
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Synth-tab primary knob `osc?Pos` (was "Position", now **Orbit Size** — i18n `label.orbitSize`) + Terrain-tab primary knob `terSize` (proxy, both move together) + big-view **wheel** (−deltaY × 0.0012); readout `50%`
- **DSP Usage:** Core 2 orbit radius `r = 0.05 + 0.95·pos`; mod destination index 1 / 2 (relabelled "OscA Orbit Size" / "OscB Orbit Size", same index) — every "Position under an LFO" idiom becomes "orbit size under an LFO"
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: synth, terrain · **no migration gate** (no O-Strata preset has shipped)

##### `oscAOrbAspect` / `oscBOrbAspect` — Orbit Aspect
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.1 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.7 (normalised 0.666667)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab knob (64 px) `terAspect` — i18n `label.orbitAspect`; readout `0.70`
- **DSP Usage:** Core 2 minor/major ratio; default < 1 for the symmetry rule (DSP-06, harness H2)
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

##### `oscAOrbRot` / `oscBOrbRot` — Orbit Rotation
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 360.0 ° (step 0.1)
- **Default:** 0.0 ° (normalised 0.000000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab knob (64 px) `terRot` — i18n `label.orbitRotation`; readout `0°`; big-view **⌥ drag** (dx × 0.5 °/px, wraps at 360)
- **DSP Usage:** Core 2 X/Y phase relationship (phase-distortion / PWM-like motion); Core 4 feedback direction û is rotated with the orbit
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain · view_alt_drag: dx

##### `oscAOrbCX` / `oscBOrbCX` — Orbit Centre X
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** -1.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.13 (normalised 0.565000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab knob (64 px) `terCX` — i18n `label.orbitCentreX`; readout `0.13`; big-view **drag** (the screen point is unprojected onto the y = 0 plane, so the centre lands under the cursor)
- **DSP Usage:** Core 2 centre offset → asymmetry / even harmonics; the orbit point is clamped to [−1, 1]² before the read
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain · view_drag: dx

##### `oscAOrbCY` / `oscBOrbCY` — Orbit Centre Y
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** -1.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.21 (normalised 0.605000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab knob (64 px) `terCY` — i18n `label.orbitCentreY`; readout `0.21`; big-view **drag** (−dy)
- **DSP Usage:** Core 2 centre offset (off-centre default per the symmetry rule: c = (0.13, 0.21), aspect 0.7, r = 0.5, F = 1 measured h1 = 0 dB)
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain · view_drag: -dy

##### `oscAOrbMod` / `oscBOrbMod` — Orbit Mod
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.5 (normalised 0.500000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab sub-row knob (56 px) `terOrbMod` — i18n `label.orbitMod`; readout `0.50`; **inert when Orbit = Ellipse**
- **DSP Usage:** Core 2 per-orbit shape input: superellipse exponent, limaçon loop, epitrochoid / hypocycloid inner ratio, butterfly lobe, squarcle corner; inert for Ellipse
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

##### `oscAOrbFeedback` / `oscBOrbFeedback` — Feedback
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.0 (normalised 0.000000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab sub-row knob (56 px) `terFb` — i18n `label.feedback` (REUSED key; the delay's Feedback knob shares it); readout `0%`; the amber feedback trail in the view is visible only when > 0
- **DSP Usage:** Core 4 trajectory feedback `p[n] = orbit(θ[n]) + fb · d[n] · û`, `d` clamped ±0.5, sampled point clamped to [−1, 1]²; DC blocker on the output; stability gate H4
- **Flags:** per-sample (**mod**) · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

##### `oscAOrbFbDamp` / `oscBOrbFbDamp` — Feedback Damp
- **Type:** Float
- **Range:** 0.0 to 1.0
- **Default:** 0.5 (normalised 0.500000)
- **Skew Factor:** linear
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab sub-row knob (56 px) `terFbDamp` — i18n `label.feedbackDamp` ("Fb Damp"); readout `50%`
- **DSP Usage:** Core 4 one-pole smoothing of the feedback displacement `d[n] = damp · d[n−1] + (1 − damp) · y[n−1]` (a_eff per D1: two-sample average + leaky integrator)
- **Flags:** block-rate · mod destination: no · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

#### Quality

##### `oscAQuality` / `oscBQuality` — Quality
- **Type:** Choice
- **Range:** Bandlimited / 2× / 4×
- **Default:** 2× (normalised 0.500000) — Stage 0 Decision 8 (2× universal; a Bandlimited default would showcase the differentiator but is approximate for 4 of 11 orbits)
- **Skew Factor:** n/a (choice)
- **UI Control:** Terrain-tab toolbar segmented control `#seg-terQuality` (proxy; "2×" / "4×" are numerals, never localised; `label.bandlimited`); comboBox relay. Bandlimited greys Pitch Track and clamps the Freq readout at 2.00×
- **DSP Usage:** Core 5 / 6 / 7: Bandlimited = Chebyshev basis at 1× with per-pitch coefficient truncation (degree-16 triangle, F ≤ 2); 2× / 4× = per-oscillator halfband polyphase IIR oversampling; never allocates on change (must-have 5); constant +1 sample latency report
- **Flags:** block-rate · mod destination: no · automatable: yes · persisted: yes · tabs: terrain

## Mod-matrix destinations — `ModDest` enum / `getModDestNames()` (46, in index order)

Indices 0–25 are O-Prism's (strings unchanged except 1 and 2); 26–45 are appended, **all of Osc A then all of Osc B**. Host-facing strings, not localised.

| # | String | Target | # | String | Target |
|---|--------|--------|---|--------|--------|
| 0 | None | — | 23 | Pitch | global pitch |
| 1 | **OscA Orbit Size** (was OscA Pos) | `oscAPos` | 24 | OscA Warp | `oscAWarpAmt` |
| 2 | **OscB Orbit Size** (was OscB Pos) | `oscBPos` | 25 | OscB Warp | `oscBWarpAmt` |
| 3 | FiltA Cut | `filtACutoff` | 26 | OscA Orbit Aspect | `oscAOrbAspect` |
| 4 | FiltB Cut | `filtBCutoff` | 27 | OscA Orbit Rot | `oscAOrbRot` |
| 5 | FiltA Res | `filtARes` | 28 | OscA Orbit CX | `oscAOrbCX` |

## Relay / attachment plumbing (Stage 3 — `PluginEditor` template `mockups/v2-PluginEditor-TEMPLATE.*`)

| Relay kind | Members | Count | IDs |
|------------|---------|-------|-----|
| `WebSliderRelay` / `WebSliderParameterAttachment` | `sliderRelays` / `sliderAttachments` | **166** | `StrataParamIds::allSliderIds()` = 24 × 2 osc + 118 other (fork's 188 − 70 baked-era osc + 48) |
| `WebComboBoxRelay` / `WebComboBoxParameterAttachment` | `comboRelays` / `comboAttachments` (NEW) | **8** | `osc{A,B}{Terrain,TerEdge,Orbit,Quality}` |
| `WebToggleButtonRelay` / `WebToggleButtonParameterAttachment` | unchanged six groups | **30** | `delaySync` 1 + `lfo{1..4}{Sync,FreeRun}` 8 + 5 bypass + 16 `modSlot?On` |
| **Total** | | **204** relays = 204 attachments | for 205 parameters — `stereoWidth` has no UI control (as in O-Prism) |

The Terrain tab's controls (`terFreq`, `terSize`, `select-terTerrain`, `#seg-terQuality` …) are **not** relays: they are JS proxies that repoint to `osc{A|B}<suffix>` (YAML `interactions.osc_toggle`).

## Non-parameter state

| State | Format | Notes |
|-------|--------|-------|
| `terrainImports/osc{A,B}Import` (APVTS state child, renamed from `geometryImports`) | `kind="png" name="…" sha256="…" bytes="N" embedded="1" data="<base64>"` or `embedded="0" path="…" sha256="…" name="…"` | Raw PNG bytes (already deflated; no gzip), ≤ 2 MB per oscillator embedded; above the cap path + SHA-256 + name. Missing file → library fallback (Sine Product) + localised `.terrain-notice` (`label.sourceMissing`). Properties round-trip as **strings** (memory `critical_valuetree_xml_roundtrip_loses_type`). Preset-manager `customSave` / `customLoad` carry the tree. |
| Chebyshev coefficient sets | runtime only | Regenerated off the audio thread per (terrain, F, Mod X, Mod Y), swapped atomically; never persisted |
| Decoded / blurred images, view caches | runtime only | Regenerated from bytes on restore (`imageGeneration[osc]` bump → import job on the message-thread timer) |
| View mode ⬡ / ≋ per canvas (A, B, big) | UI only | Not a parameter; not persisted; default `3d` |
| Terrain-tab active oscillator | UI only | Default A; repoints the two dropdowns, the Quality segment and both panel cards |
| `uiLanguage`, `tuningEngine` state | inherited | unchanged from O-Prism |

## View push contract (Stage 3 — not parameters, listed because the editor template implements them)

| Event | Rate | Payload | Notes |
|-------|------|---------|-------|
| `terrainState` | 30 Hz, change-gated per oscillator | `{osc:"A"\|"B", theta, x, y}` (< 100 bytes) | `emitEventIfBrowserIsVisible` → `window.__JUCE__.backend.addEventListener('terrainState', …)`; **never** `evaluateJavascript` (memory `critical_webview_completion_gated_on_isvisible`) |
| `terrainHeightmap` | on terrain-parameter change, ≤ 10 Hz | `{osc, n:64, data:<base64 Float32 LE, 64×64>}` | R32F texture in the WebGL2 path; PNG / Chebyshev-truncated / pitch-tracked surface — the JS analytic mirror is only the pre-push fallback |
| `terrainStatus` | on change | `{osc, sourceMissing, fit, partials, approx}` | readout facts only C++ knows; overrides the JS estimate |
| `heldNotes` | 30 Hz, change-gated | `{notes:[…], freqs:[…]}` | replaces the fork's `evaluateJavascript("window.updateHeldNotes(…)")` |
| re-push | after preset apply / `setStateInformation` | all of the above | JS calls native `requestTerrainRepush` from `__refreshAllControls` and once at load |

Native functions the page calls (NEW): `chooseTerrainImage(osc)` (FileChooser, `launchAsync` + `SafePointer`, never `complete()` on the dead path), `importTerrainImageData(osc, name, base64)` (PNG drop — bytes streamed, WKWebView strips paths), `requestTerrainRepush()`. Removed with the wavetable library: `getActiveOscInfo`, `getActiveOscFrame` (Phase 2.1).

## Parameter Groups

**Osc A / Osc B (28 × 2 = 56):** rows 1–28 of the APVTS-order table, Osc A block then Osc B block.
**Sub / Noise (6):** `subShape subOctave subLevel noiseType noiseLevel subRouting`
**Envelopes (10):** `amp{Attack,Decay,Sustain,Release} filt{Attack,Decay,Sustain,Release} filt{A,B}EnvDepth`
**Filters (11):** `filt{A,B}{Type,Cutoff,Res,Drive,KeyTrack} filtRouting`
**Tuning / global pitch (7):** `tuningPreset tonic masterTune octaveStretch pitchBendRange glideMode glideTime`
**Effects (27):** reverb 7 · delay 7 · chorus 4 · distortion 4 · EQ 5 (each with its `*Bypass`)
**LFOs (20):** `lfo{1..4}{Rate,Shape,Sync,Division,FreeRun}`
**Mod matrix (64):** `modSlot{0..15}{Src,Dst,Amt,On}` — `Dst` list is the 46 above
**Master (4):** `masterVol stereoWidth oscMix velocityCurve`

## Notes

- Parameters are implemented in EXACT order during the Stage 1 second pass: `createOscParameters("oscA")`, `createOscParameters("oscB")` (28 each, table order), then the inherited sections in O-Prism's `createParameterLayout()` order.
- Parameter IDs must remain consistent across all stages; the `param-dump` target must report **205 rows**, and the diff against O-Prism v1.24.0's `params.tsv` must be exactly −2 (`osc?Table`) +34 (new) with `osc?Pos` default / `osc?Unison` max / `modSlot?Dst` steps changed in place (FUNC-09).
- UI controls are implemented from the finalized mockup (`mockups/v2-ui.html`, `v2-ui.yaml`) during Stage 3 (GUI); the relay plumbing is in `mockups/v2-PluginEditor-TEMPLATE.*`.
- Choice lists are append-only once v1.0.0 ships; `Imported…` stays the last Terrain index; every future range change needs its own preset-migration gate.
